info.title: ReserveFlow REST API
info.description: Tenant-scoped inventory holds. All examples are synthetic. Expiry is derived using expiresAt <= current server time. Idempotency replays the original response, including its original timestamps and state.

200.description: Tenant products ordered by increasing ID

post.description: Create initial stock. SKU is unique per tenant. Product creation has no idempotency replay; a repeated SKU returns 409. No query parameters.

get.description: reserved sums held reservations whose expiresAt is strictly after server time. available = onHand - reserved. Confirmations decrement onHand.

200.description: Tenant reservations ordered by increasing ID, with derived expired state

post.description: Reserve stock for 1..3600 seconds. Same tenant key + normalized request replays original bytes/status. Different payload or route using the same key returns 409. Availability failures are persisted and replayed; use a new key for a new attempt. No query parameters.

201.description: Hold created or original hold response replayed

get.description: Read current effective state. Use this endpoint after an old idempotent response is replayed.

post.description: Confirm an unexpired hold and atomically decrement onHand. Send {}. Same key replays success; a new key on a terminal reservation returns 409. No query parameters.
Cancel an unexpired hold. onHand does not change. Send {}. No query parameters.

get.description: Committed product/hold/confirm/cancel events, scoped to the authenticated tenant. Expiry is derived and does not create an audit event.

200.description: Audit events ordered by increasing ID

TenantKey.description: 64-character local synthetic tenant API key. The API process receives only its SHA-256 digest.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned for the same tenant and resource. Pagination is forward-only and is not a historical snapshot.

ReservationOK.description: Transition committed or original response replayed

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON object, fields, ID, query or Idempotency-Key

Unauthorized.description: Missing or incorrect tenant API key

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist for this tenant

Conflict.description: Duplicate SKU, insufficient stock, terminal state, or Idempotency-Key reused for another request

Gone.description: Hold has expired at server time

Unavailable.description: Database operation failed or timed out. Retry a write using its original key; commit acknowledgement can be uncertain.
